headline: What to Do When Your Water Line Bursts in Henderson?
articleBody:
Discovering a burst water line in your Henderson home can be pretty stressful, but knowing the right steps can help minimize damage. First things first, you need to shut off your main water supply. This is usually located near your water meter or where the main line enters your home. If you're unsure, try to locate it beforehand to save crucial time. Next, if the leak is near any electrical outlets or appliances, play it safe and shut off the power to that area from your main breaker. Don't risk standing in water if there's electricity nearby. After you've stopped the water flow and secured the electrical, it's time to call in the pros.

### What to Expect During the Process
When CG Plumbing Solutions arrives, our licensed plumbers will quickly assess the situation. We'll identify the exact failure point, which might involve a bit of detection work, especially if the leak is concealed. We’ll talk you through whether it’s a simple repair or if more extensive work, like excavation, is needed. Our team will replace or repair the damaged section, restore your water service, and thoroughly check for any other leaks. We pride ourselves on clear communication and providing written options before any work begins, ensuring you understand the scope and safety requirements. Our goal is to get your water line fixed correctly and get your home back to normal with minimal fuss.

When a major water line issue strikes, you want reliable, expert help. Don't hesitate to reach out to CG Plumbing Solutions for immediate assistance.
